# Threshold sensitivity (generated by scripts/sensitivity.py)

Recorded telemetry of the 650 leaderboard episodes, rescored with one threshold scaled at a time. Baseline: strict PASS 102, full 95, zero 441. Ranking statistics compare the 14 model graded means (Kendall τ-b and Spearman ρ, ties averaged). Not perturbed (hard-coded in function bodies): conflict factor 0.35, evidence factor 0.75, safety steps 0.25/0.10/0, action-curve weights. A single deterministic run per stack: these numbers describe scorer sensitivity, not run-to-run stability.
